preconditions.expression: all(2 <= int(line.split()[0]) <= 200000 for line in stdin.splitlines()[0:1]) and all(1 <= int(line.split()[1]) <= 200000 for line in stdin.splitlines()[0:1]) and all(1 <= int(line.split()[2]) <= int(stdin.splitlines()[0].split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[0:1])
preconditions.description: The first line contains three integers n, m, k where 2 ≤ n ≤ 2e5, 1 ≤ m ≤ 2e5, and 1 ≤ k ≤ n.

preconditions.expression: len(stdin.splitlines()) == m + 1 and all(len(line.split()) == 2 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: There are exactly m lines of swaps after the first line, each containing two integers x_i and y_i.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= int(stdin.splitlines()[0].split()[0]) and 1 <= int(y) <= int(stdin.splitlines()[0].split()[0]) and int(x) != int(y) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for x, y in [line.split()])
preconditions.description: Each swap (x_i, y_i) satisfies 1 ≤ x_i, y_i ≤ n and x_i ≠ y_i.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip().split() == [str(min_fakes(i)) for i in range(1, int(stdin.splitlines()[0].split()[0]) + 1)]
postconditions.description: For each position i (1 ≤ i ≤ n), the output contains the minimum number of swaps to fake so the special ball ends at position i, or -1 if it's impossible.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(out) <= m or int(out) == -1 for out in stdout.strip().split())
postconditions.description: Each output value is either a non-negative integer ≤ m (number of fakes) or -1 (impossible).

postconditions.expression: all(len(out) == 1 or (out[0] == '-' and out[1] == '1') for out in [stdout.strip().split()[i] for i in range(len(stdout.strip().split()))])
postconditions.description: Each output value is either a single digit or '-1'.
